notes.title: We've released a patch! Here's what's in it!
notes.content:
[h1]PC fixes now live (All Platforms)
[/h1]

[h2]Advanced Settings Placement
[/h2]
Advanced graphics settings have been moved to the bottom of the list for better visibility.

[h2]Updated Translations (Steam Only)
[/h2]
Improved Chinese translations have been added to the game.

[h2]DLSS and Streamline Updates[/h2]
Fixed crashes when using Windows + D or Alt + Tab.
Resolved crashes occurring when the game is left idle.
Stuttering Improvements (Windows Store / Game Pass)
Addressed stuttering issues during gameplay.

[h2]PlayStation 5 Controller Support
[/h2]DualSense controllers are now supported across all PC platforms.

[h2]Updated Credits[/h2]
The game credits have been updated.
[h2]
Subtitle Fixes[/h2]
Fixed issues where subtitles were missing or lacked drop shadows.
[h2]
Powder and Steel Quest Fixes
[/h2]
Improved visibility for the “Defeat the enemy” quest step.
Added an additional marker for Jung after defeating the revenant.
Fixed an issue preventing progression after defeating Rammuha.

[h2]Resolution Settings
[/h2]
Players can now adjust their resolution in both fullscreen and borderless modes.

Thanks so much for playing!

~ Team Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn

notes.title: We're squashing some bugs.
notes.content:
Sappers! We have been hard at work fixing some issues that have been reported since our launch.

[b]This list is not exhaustive,[/b] but some of the problems that we are looking to fix are:

[list]
[*] Crashes on Windows PC when using Win+D
[*] NVIDIA Reflex causing stuttering on Windows PC
[*] PlayStation controller compatibility for PC
[*] Various progression blockers covering all platforms
[*] HDR issues on the Xbox platform
[*] Making the Advanced Settings section more clear within graphics options
[*] Translation issues (incorrect languages being shown)
[/list]

We will communicate a date for this patch as soon as we can. 

Thank you all for your patience!

~ The Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn Team

notes.title: Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn | Out Now!
notes.content:
Sappers! 

We are delighted to announce the release of Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn, our explosive Action-RPG Souls-like where guns and Gods collide in a battle for the future of humanity, 

[previewyoutube=RUVkGaAW-8w;full][/previewyoutube]

Join Nor and her mysterious fox-like companion, Enki, as they unite against the old Gods to free the besieged lands of Kian. Traverse deserts, ruins, and towering cities in a pursuit of vengeance and freedom.

Tailor your gameplay with an extensive array of skills, weapons, and gear. Delve into intricate skill trees that include Combat Skills for enhancing melee and ranged attacks, Magic Abilities to harness arcane power, and Companion Abilities to boost Enki’s support in battle. Craft and upgrade your arsenal, mastering a blend of physical and magical prowess. Dive into side quests and explore the world to discover hidden collectibles, gear, and crafting materials to enhance Nor's equipment

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/3061bb26258988103122f4e7d49e8d783bb45aa6.png[/img]

Some Sapper Essentials:

[list]
[*] You can still [url=https://www.playflintlock.com/]join the coalition[/url] and receive some exclusive subscriber rewards
[*] Head over to the Steam Discussion Boards to leave your tips, tricks, and feedback!
[/list]

The Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn OST is also [url=lnk.to/flintlock]available now[/url] on all major streaming platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/b4a8b1dab28a4f75982656889841593bd1617ec8.png[/img]

Gunpowder at the ready! 

We're so thankful for your support! To everybody who has played our demo, and to those of you who are just discovering us for the first time, we hope you have a BLAST. 

No Rest 'Til Dawn!

~ The Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn Team

Before you get stuck in, take a moment to check these videos out. They give an overview of our gameplay, RPG elements, and our Story...

notes.title: Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn | Story Trailer
notes.content:
"Dawn burned. And the Gods ran awry."

Prepare to confront the relentless fury of the Gods. Take a first look at the Gods, and learn about their motivations in our latest trailer.

[previewyoutube=nzlwZVGxfO4;full][/previewyoutube]

Unleashed upon the world, the vengeful Gods are wreaking havoc, determined to bring chaos and the downfall of mankind. 

[h1]Meet the Gods 
[/h1]
[h2]Dukmar
[/h2]
Dukmar controls Wanderer’s Rest, an ancient region that was once Kian’s cradle of civilization and is now the center of learning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/3c8859fda9098088a76d78319936242a5976f2d7.png[/img]

A self-proclaimed God of Knowledge, Dukmar's understanding of the world is skewed by larger-than-life stories passed on to him by the souls of the Great Below. Unfortunately, these stories often feature conquerors and tyrants, inspiring Dukmar to seek similar dominance. 

[h2]Rammuha[/h2]

Rammuha rules over Three Peaks, leveraging the conservative beliefs of its people to maintain control without revealing herself directly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/f67596b4ca59cc35f94091bf92d035f314ebf395.png[/img]

As a Goddess of Order, her perception of the world is influenced by flawed mortal ideas of rules and justice. Always in the shadow of more powerful Gods in the Great Below, Rammuha has become a cunning and resourceful adversary. 

[h2]Inaya[/h2]
Inaya, the Goddess of Life, works tirelessly to maintain the natural order of the world. Unlike the other Gods, she is dedicated to her duties and has no interest in invading the Above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/3061bb26258988103122f4e7d49e8d783bb45aa6.png[/img]

[h2]Uru[/h2]
Uru controls Dawn itself, never letting the Door to the Great Below out of his sight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/2b032063c56fe0bd2db1313bc9c3e7352046c71c.png[/img]

Known as Uru the Ravager, he is the most powerful of the Gods, tasked with controlling the Door between life and death. All the other Gods fear Uru’s power. The only force capable of restraining him is the Door itself, which he cannot venture far from.

Traverse the devastated lands of Kian, harness Enki's magic, and soar through the skies using portals while facing the relentless Army of the Dead. Discover new equipment, fortify your weapons, and upgrade your gear in preparation for the ultimate showdown against the Gods.

Pre-orders are open, and you can still download and play our Demo if you have yet to try it out for yourself. 

Thank you so much for your support so far - we are so excited for next week. If you haven't done so yet, you can join the coalition and snag yourself some exclusive subscriber rewards - including some awesome Concept Art and a phone wallpaper. Show no mercy, Sapper! 

See you on July 18! 

~ The Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn Team ⚔️

notes.title: New gameplay alert!
notes.content:
Summer 2024 is approaching fast… 

[previewyoutube=debAPFFUL-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Today at IGN FanFest, we revealed a compilation of Gameplay Clips that showcase some previously unseen elements from the game. Here’s a fresh look at Nor, her mysterious fox-like companion Enki, and the world of Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn.

[h1]Hosts[/h1]

The gameplay preview starts with a warm offer of coffee from a Host. Hosts, despite their otherworldly appearance, are the friendliest faces in every hamlet or town. Legends say that beneath the tangles of limbs and layers of complex fabrics, lies a creature seeking refuge. They make a wonderful cup of coffee - and often offer you something stronger. Perhaps a healing flask will see you well..? 

Take care, good host.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/e413b291699c60a74fbe4180445278671c2197a7.png[/img]

[h1]Combat [/h1]

You then follow Nor as she exits the Coffee Shop, and enters a battle with a group of Lost Souls. These conscripts of the Undead Army have been dragged above the Great Below to fight on behalf of the Gods. Enki can be seen prepping these enemies for critical hits using a curse, which makes them easy targets for Nor a she lands a critical melee with her Axe, followed by a swift shot with her pistol. These curse, melee, and primary fire combinations are something we’ve worked hard on to bring you satisfying combat experiences. They’re super fun to execute! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/310a39da7d382b1591df3b541507561590c98984.png[/img]

Nor continues on and encounters an enemy with projectile weapons called a Cannoneer. Quite a grotesque form of mobile artillery - the Gods fused their bodies around a pair of cannons. Nor uses her Destructive Descent to knock back and damage the enemy, and uses a series of Shadow Charges, melee attacks, and pistol shots to defeat him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/5b064d0bc82d28689718434aa0f141397792d9c6.png[/img]

[h1]Lodestones[/h1] 

Lodestones are areas of rest where you can replenish energy and consumables, as well as alter your skill tree. Unlike campsites however, you cannot upgrade your weapons here. You see these briefly in the gameplay teaser - Enki particularly likes to rest precisely in the middle of them. Using one of these will bank your reputation (that is the percentage you see on the left of the HUD - it’s essentially an XP multiplier that breaks when you take damage of any kind). You spend those points on the Skill Tree in game - more will be revealed on that in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/0048282d8fd0bb896084b3cdb845eb92ddbd7e02.png[/img]


[h1]Boss Battles [/h1]

Nor’s next altercation is with the aptly named The Annihilator. All boss battles in the game come with a unique enemy, who has their own fighting style and combat patterns - and in the case of the Annihilator, his crude (but effective) shield requires disarming before significant damage can be inflicted on him. You’ll learn how to disarm shielded enemies early in the game - and Nor does so with her axe. He also leaks a corrosive fluid - gross, but something to be aware of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/f79e456e0c9f8e76dedcb9c123227d50fb6a47d3.png[/img]

[h1]Rifting[/h1]

Nor opens a Rift so that she can leave the area and gain some height to survey the next location. Rifting is a mechanic that aims to hep you get to previously inaccessible areas and to help you advance the story or your missions  - so if you’re ever stuck, ask yourself, “should I look for a Rift..?” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110188/f0b4aa4bee7df5680c3fb50cd05fb73d054a4b8b.png[/img]

[h1]Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn is out Summer 2024 
[/h1]

Don’t forget to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=debAPFFUL-0]watch the full Gameplay Teaser[/url] if you haven’t already… and stay tuned, because next month we’ll be bringing you an Extended Gameplay Reveal, so that you can take an even closer look at what we’ve been working on.

We can’t wait to get it into your hands. 

See you soon!
